Your universe belongs to you.

Órbita 0.4.0 works without accounts, ads, purchases, trackers or analytics services.

What is saved

Your scores, lights, worlds, personal planets, components, milestones, challenge codes, recent journeys and settings stay on this device. They are not sent to a server. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data may remove them.

Controls

Settings lets you turn off audio, vibration and ambient motion, or reset your progress. Vibration requires a compatible device.

Test version

This is a local test version. Before a store release, the privacy policy needs the publisher's identity and contact details, and the store declarations must be completed.
